assertions.name: sign_flip_structural_and_robust
assertions.source: S odd in eps (bar-odd parity) + small sign-flipped eps in both derived proxies

description: Candidate-(iii) linear-response structure for the c₃ bar-odd S decay projection (follow-up to merged #3600). Formalize-first: (1) S is bar-odd under σ:q↦q⁻¹, and q=q₀+iε sends ε↦−ε/q₀² so S(−ε)=−S(ε)+O(ε²) — S∝ε with sign S = sign ε, making the muon>0>proton sign-flip STRUCTURAL, not a fit (numeric witness: Im T(q0+iε) odd + ≈ε·T'(q0)). (2) The linear coefficient ∂S/∂ε is derived up to proxy: geometric (u=2log q, 4√3 log q0/q0) and operator (fig-8 trace T'(q0), #3600) both give small sign-flipped ε at both anchors; |ε| is proxy-dependent. Residue: ε(q₀) itself (=arg(u(q₀))), one open real function, in scope under the opened Subgoal-2 but not fit/wired. Scope-(a); C14; no c_k wired; no fit.

sign_flip_structural.argument: sigma:q->1/q sends eps->-eps/q0^2 (leading); bar-odd => S(-eps)=-S(eps) => sign S = sign eps

robustness.residue: eps(q0) itself = arg(u(q0)); one open real function; Subgoal-2 open
